title: You are a headless build session for Brett's AmberX-AXF repo (this worktree, branch claude/ui-all-a…
asked: You are a headless build session for Brett's AmberX-AXF repo (this worktree, branch claude/ui-all-assets). Read CLAUDE.md, _claude/shared/rules/RULES.md and _claude/rules/RULES.md first. Work on Opus. One session, no sub-agents. GOAL: Brett says "the screen don't look tighter". The scale assets (typography, density, sizing — PR #181, already on main) exist but only 1 screen uses them. Finish the Angel `ui-all-assets` build (_claude/builds/profiles/angel/orchestrator.json, steps s1–s5): apply the scale assets to EVERY console screen and plugin page (apps/console-web/src + apps/console-web/plugins/*/web), AmberX (apps/amberx-droid) and the Android framework where the steps say so. Default density = compact: smaller type, tighter padding/gaps/row heights, small badges, no wasted space, still tappable on a phone. Theme tokens only (--fx-*), framework controls only, no var() fallbacks. 1. `git merge origin/main` first. 2. Do the steps, ticking each in the orchestrator. 3. Take before/after screenshots of 6+ console screens with the existing screenshot tools (Playwright is installed) and put them in _claude/builds/reports/ui-all-assets/. 4. Run the full local test block (.github/workflows/android.yml web tests), lifecycle check, theme/controls checks. All green. (If agent-swarm already fixed the plan-studio lifecycle line on main, merge main again.) 5. Push branch, then merge origin/main again, retest, `git push origin HEAD:main`. 6. Report in detailed style (screen/plugin touched, what was loose, what changed) in _claude/builds/reports/ui-all-assets-<date>.md, committed with the push.

result.summary: ui-all-assets s3–s5: tighter compact scale defaults; ~1,720 sizes in 80 files moved to typography/density/sizing tokens (console, all plugin pages, libs, AmberX, axhub-web, Walkthrough, templates); check-theme rule scale; theme-swap swaps the 3 types; design packages name them; main's red CI fixed (lifecycle refs, menu-reach). Pushed to main 10dea235.
